assumptions.scope: NASA-publication-based algorithm architecture adapted to a crew walk, independently implemented; not NASA flight software, validated astronaut mobility limits, GESTALT or ACE.
assumptions.clearance: 0.45 m illustrative body radius plus 0.55 m planning margin = 1 m. Dilate every hard hazard from its full cell box to full candidate cell boxes, so the complete path has conservative clearance. Includes unknown coverage and map boundary.
assumptions.roughness: Least-squares plane fitted to each native 3x3 height window. RMS residual <= 0.10 m and maximum absolute residual <= 0.25 m are demo limits, not NASA values. Orbital residuals are not a measured rock size, vertical step or soil bearing strength.
assumptions.globalPlanner: Uniform-grid Field D*: g/rhs consistency, priority queue, linear cost interpolation across cardinal-diagonal neighbour pairs, incremental cost repair. Uses the documented centre-cell-only variant, no bottom-cell shortcut, no flight lookup table; h=0 produces a reusable full goal field. Nodes are native cell centres; cost squares lie between four centres.
assumptions.costs: Distance priority uses density 1; terrain priority uses maximum of four densities 1 + 4*(native slope/20 deg)^2 + 2*(plane RMS/0.10 m)^2. A cost square is blocked if any corner cell fails full-cell clearance or either native triangle gradient exceeds 20 deg. Global objective is a 2D cost field, not exact minimum 3D walking distance.
assumptions.localPlanner: Crew can step in any heading: candidates use 32 headings plus direct target and Field D* successor guidance, over 1 m and 0.5 m steps. Hard native-height and footprint checks precede ranking by integrated local cost + global cost-to-go + 0.05 m-equivalent per radian turn. Goal cost must decrease. Fail explicitly on a stall; no silent fallback. Local search is heuristic, not a global optimality guarantee.
assumptions.nativeValidation: Piecewise-planar interpolation on the complete native grid; split at cell boundaries, interpolation patch lines and diagonals. Check exact touched native cells, unknown/exclusion/roughness inflation, source support and signed grade on every resulting linear piece.
assumptions.unknown: Unknown and outside-map terrain remain blocked. Deliberate conservative difference from MER's exploratory finite-cost unknown-cell policy.
assumptions.return: Static symmetric crew constraints permit reversed geometry. Revalidate native pieces, signed grades, cost and positive climb separately for return. No heading-dependent rover suspension model.
assumptions.sensing: All terrain currently comes from a static orbital product. No simulated sensor data is represented as measured stereo, odometry, rock detection or live observations.
assumptions.time: No verified walking speed, metabolic or operational timing model; estimated time stays null.
